variants.shipped: complianceEngine v4 as shipped (tonne thresholds; 500 h PTE for emergency engines; AP-42 HAP factors; WHO noise advisory; NAAQS on background + population-weighted increment)
variants.legacy_v3: v3 rule set on the v3 exposure metric: thresholds 100/50/10/5 compared with tonnes, actual runtime hours, formaldehyde 0.08 g/kWh for every engine type, WHO noise classed regulatory, NAAQS on the 1-km centreline increment alone (no background)
variants.actual_hours: Title V / HAP applicability on ACTUAL runtime hours instead of the 500 h potential-to-emit basis
variants.noise_regulatory: WHO 70 dBA guideline classed as regulatory (v3 tier)
variants.naaqs_centreline: NAAQS on background + the 1-km centreline increment (the conservative v3 exposure metric) instead of the population-weighted increment

note: v4 evaluates NAAQS on the monitored background (pm25Background, EPA AirData single-year means) plus the population-weighted increment; legacy_v3 and naaqs_centreline use the 1-km centreline increment that healthEngine v4 still reports. Jurisdiction-specific noise ordinances are not evaluated.
